entries.spelling: B, R, I, E, F, I, N, G
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，简报，情况通报，行前说明

entries.zh: 首席执行官将在上午九时就第四季度重点做简短通报。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，主持人，协调人，版主

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，法定人数，开会最低出席人数

entries.zh: 因董事会未达法定人数，表决被推迟。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，重新召开，再集会

entries.spelling: S, P, O, K, E, S, P, E, R, S, O, N
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，发言人，代言人

entries.spelling: A, B, S, E, N, T, E, E, I, S, M
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，旷工，缺勤率，经常性缺席
entries.en: The HR team launched a wellness program to reduce absenteeism across all departments.

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，分配额，配额，拨出份额

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，欠款，拖欠款项，逾期未付款
entries.en: The tenant paid three months of rent arrears before renewing the lease.
entries.zh: 租户在续租前结清了三个月的租金欠款。

entries.spelling: F, U, R, L, O, U, G, H
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，强制休假，临时停薪留职，准假
entries.en: Due to the seasonal downturn, the factory placed 200 workers on unpaid furlough.
entries.zh: 因季节性业务下滑，工厂安排 200 名工人无薪强制休假。

entries.spelling: G, R, I, E, V, A, N, C, E
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，投诉，不满，劳资申诉
entries.en: Employees who feel unfairly treated may file a formal grievance with HR.
entries.zh: 觉得受到不公对待的员工可向人力资源部门提出正式申诉。

entries.spelling: H, A, N, D, O, V, E, R
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，交接，移交，职责转交

entries.zh: 即将离任的经理为继任者准备了详细的交接备注。

entries.spelling: O, U, T, P, L, A, C, E, M, E, N, T
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，再就业安置服务，裁员辅导，转职协助
entries.en: Laid-off staff were offered six months of outplacement services at no cost.
entries.zh: 被裁员工可免费获得六个月的再就业安置服务。

entries.spelling: P, I, P, E, L, I, N, E
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，管道，项目储备，待推进事项流
entries.en: Several promising deals are still in the sales pipeline for next quarter.
entries.zh: 下个季度仍有几笔有前景的交易处于销售储备中。

entries.spelling: P, U, S, H, B, A, C, K
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，阻力，反对意见，推回/抵制
entries.en: The pricing proposal faced strong pushback from regional sales managers.
entries.zh: 该定价提案遭到区域销售经理的强烈反对。

entries.spelling: R, E, B, R, A, N, D
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，品牌重塑，更换品牌形象，再品牌化

entries.zh: 该公司计划将平价产品线重塑为高端生活方式品牌。
